hypothesis: The independently trained V53 piano and V54 wrong-pitch specialists have complementary validation gains. One preregistered union may retain both benefits while all existing per-recording protection gates remain mandatory.
selection: Use all 144 original validation settings per study. Each member must preserve all 381 timed and 237 pitch-only recordings at both policies. Role A is V53, additionally requiring positive real-piano and NRG-CP gains at both policies; role B is V54, additionally requiring positive TinySOL wrong-pitch gains at both policies. Deterministic priority is frozen in left_ensemble_v56.selection_key. Choose one member of each role before any joint predictions. Each retains its own checkpoint and training-only normalizer, original threshold and independent frame veto. Union only additional removal permissions, followed by immutable V43 permissions. V38 full-context releases run before deletion. No newly fitted weights or failed V52 members.
release_requirements: Require full joint per-recording preservation and positive overall, real-piano, NRG-CP and TinySOL gains at both policies. Only then all 603 consumed regressions. Only after complete consumed preservation and benefit, one untouched 40-clip original/texture MP3 first pass with separate positive family gains. No runner-up, retuning or replacement clips after failure. Portable/full-context runtime parity and native functional checks before deployment.
